title: Fourier granularity
statement: A function $f$ on the sign cube is Fourier granular with parameter $\varepsilon$ if every Fourier coefficient of $f$ is an integer multiple of $\varepsilon$; that is, for each subset $S$ of coordinates, there is an integer $z$ such that $\widehat f(S)=z\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the sign cube to the real numbers
